title: US human therapeutic-biotech scope requirements review
scope: FDA-facing human therapeutic biotechnology, biologics, vaccines, biosimilars and relevant combination products, with shared study documents. This is an audit requirements checklist, not a second filing registry or exhaustive legal universe.
denominatorLimit: 32USpharma_biotech and17GLOBALmedicinal registry rows are an observed catalogue denominator only. They omit cross-segment vaccineEUA/RFD and some mechanism/product-specific obligations. They cannot prove all plausible USbiotech filings.
method: Read current publicFDA/eCFR/vendor pages and inspect existing canonical owners. Current code is changing in sibling scopes; this read-only review does not mark implementation or release readiness verified. Source fetch success alone is not application-specific regulatory verification.

rows.need: Initial commercial/investigator IND development appropriate to actual drug/biologic/vaccine/cell-gene product.
rows.observedLimit: An initial dossier scaffold and200INDstarts do not establish source completeness or validated submission. Official forms and underlying studies remain originals.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Recorded product/filing context through source intake, appropriate M1-M5 documents, manual/AnA drafting, review and export; original-form and package validation evidence separately.

rows.need: Distinct protocol, information and CMC amendments and complete response to clinical hold.
rows.observedLimit: Generic amendment identity previously collapsed distinct records. Twelve lifecycle starts now include these four; runtime/persistence qualification belongs to current increment, not this public-source audit.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Exact subtype/response issues retained in source and saved guidance; original1571/supporting documents protected; source drift and response revision ownership checked.

rows.need: Pre-IND, EOP2, pre-NDA/pre-BLA and applicable TypeA/B/C/D/INTERACT preparation.
rows.observedLimit: TypeD/INTERACT references and AnA formal-meeting support exist; no separately indexed exact editor starts were found in this audit. PDUFA procedures must not be generalized to BsUFA/other programs.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Exact meeting program/subtype and questions/positions; current applicable instructions and deadlines; source-specific package start and complete editor roundtrip.

rows.need: Protocol/amendments, IB, SAP, ICF, CSR, blankCRF/specifications and development safety documents.
rows.observedLimit: Detailed outlines exist. Missing exact metadata had blocked AnA; sibling work addresses this. Blank consent/CRF drafting cannot create executed consents, patient records or validated study results.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Source-supported narrative admission and original-record manual refusal; create/reopen, source attribution and editor review/export proof for each document family.

rows.need: Pharmacology, PK/toxicokinetic, toxicology and integrated nonclinical overviews/summaries.
rows.observedLimit: Existing M4/2.4/2.6 sources and templates are credited; a source-supported summary does not substitute for actual study reports, GLP statements or validated tables.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Correct study/source version and product/stage applicability; numerical and cross-section consistency; preserve original study outputs and signatures.

rows.need: Quality summaries and product-specific drug-substance/drug-product, comparability, stability, facilities and manufacturing evidence.
rows.observedLimit: Existing CMC composition is bounded to small-molecule USIND. Broad authoring templates do not prove deterministic biologic/vaccine/CGT composition, analytical validation or manufacturing readiness.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Authoring from verified controlled sources for each modality; distinguish narrative preparation from deterministic calculations, register-derived outputs and original manufacturing records.

rows.need: NDA and reliance-based505(b)(2) dossier development with appropriate referenced evidence.
rows.observedLimit: Existing registry/blueprints provide starts; an IND-like shell does not prove marketing dossier sufficiency or authorized reliance on another application.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Filing-guided projects and complete applicable components, source/reference authorization, integrated summaries, labeling and actual governed authoring/export.

rows.need: Standalone BLA development for the actual biologic/vaccine/cell-gene modality and FDA center.
rows.observedLimit: Existing BLA template does not establish modality-specific potency, comparability, immunogenicity, adventitious-agent/facility or validation evidence.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Recorded351(a)scope and modality, product/manufacturing/nonclinical/clinical/labeling source coverage, exact named working documents and human scientific review.

rows.need: Biosimilar and, where sought, interchangeability development with a specified reference product.
rows.observedLimit: Existing351(k)row/start must not be treated as an ordinary351(a)BLA or automatic interchangeability proof. FDA describes product-specific evaluation of biosimilarity/reference-product evidence.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Reference product, proposed biosimilar/interchangeable claim, applicable comparative evidence and filing-specific plan/context retained through authoring.

rows.need: ISS/ISE as distinct integrated safety/effectiveness work products, not CSR aliases.
rows.observedLimit: Detailed records existed without exact editor starts. Current lifecycle work reaches them; validated pooled analyses and original tables remain separate from prose generation.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Pooling/estimand/source versions, source-supported narrative, original exposure/demographic tables manual, cross-document consistency and current saved-source provenance.

rows.need: Applicable orphan, FastTrack, breakthrough, RMAT, priority/accelerated pathways, rolling submission and pediatric requests/plans.
rows.observedLimit: These are separate eligibility/procedure decisions, not automatic approvals. Detailed current program instructions, waiver/deferral and follow-up variants have not all been independently re-read in this audit.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Current program-specific authority/applicability, requested action and source support; distinctions among a request, designation decision and marketing application.

rows.need: Product-appropriate prior-approval, CBE30/CBE0, labeling and manufacturing change packages.
rows.observedLimit: Separate CBE starts read existing NDA/ANDA314.70records. Licensed biologic changes use601.12; they are not independently modeled by those NDA CBE parts. SUPAC is not a universal biologics change pathway.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Actual product/application/change category, approved baseline and affected sections, exact original forms/labeling, current regulatory classification and independent approval gates.

rows.need: IND annual progress and postapproval NDA/BLA obligations must stay distinct.
rows.observedLimit: US_NDA_ANNUAL is titled NDA/BLA but its source parts follow314.81(b)(2) and explicitly do not model all licensed-biologic reports. BLA minor-change601.12(d), pediatric601.28, postmarketing-study601.70 and distribution600.81 obligations are distinct;600.81 is not simply an annual NDA report.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Document subtype-specific original sources and applicable interval; separate annual/periodic obligations and current effective rules. DSUR/PBRER cannot silently substitute for a US-required report without applicable authority.

rows.need: IND and postmarketing case safety assessments, follow-up and actual structured individual case reporting.
rows.observedLimit: E2B services exist. Narrative safety worksheets are not validated ICSRs or agency delivery. FDA current page uses AEMS, with ESGNextGen E2B(R3) postmarketing transition2026-10-01 and commercial IND electronic reporting condition from2026-04-01; SRP and BA/BE pathways differ.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Report subtype and sponsor/channel applicability; exact approved case data, message validation, current regional implementation/terminology, transmission onboarding and acknowledgment evidence separately.

rows.need: Postmarketing study requirements/commitments, protocols, status/progress reports and fulfillment submissions.
rows.observedLimit: Registry and lifecycle components are credited. An authored report or populated task does not establish fulfillment, milestones or FDA release of a commitment.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Exact obligation/source letter, current status/milestones, correct protocol/report working documents and independently supported fulfillment state.

rows.need: CDER drug master files and applicable CBER master files, amendments and letters of authorization.
rows.observedLimit: Master-file references/tools/templates exist. A generic DMF worksheet is not an independently approved application or universal BLA authorization to reference any restricted content.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Current MF type/center/application-specific permission, holder/applicant distinction, authorized reference and confidential-part boundaries; original LOA and source visibility retained.

rows.need: US prescribing information, patient/MedicationGuide and container/carton content plus applicable structured labeling.
rows.observedLimit: US labeling/SPL engines exist; EU SmPC is not a USPI substitute. Editor narrative/layout and a structurally valid SPL skeleton do not prove current FDA SPL validity, registration/listing or promotional submission completeness.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Retained product/version, section content and identifiers, source/editor/SPL roundtrip, current external validation and correct delivery procedure; original approved labeling/version preserved.

rows.need: Individual-patient emergency/nonemergency, intermediate-size and treatment-use mechanisms.
rows.observedLimit: Existing framework/recommendation routes and references are present. No exact expanded-access editor/Form3926 asset/start was found in the searched canonical registry, component library and forms registry. Form3926 is a licensed-physician individual-patient path, not a universal group/sponsor IND form.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Mechanism-specific eligibility and actual physician/manufacturer/IRB sources, correct official-form original and current follow-up/reporting; exact source-guided working document and form workflow.

rows.need: Emergency authorization preparation for the actual drug/biologic/vaccine and currently applicable declaration.
rows.observedLimit: US_EUA includes vaccine productClass but current row/outline is device/assay-oriented. This cannot substantiate therapeutic/vaccine EUA authoring. EUA applicability and declaration status change over time.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Product/center/declaration-specific data and authorization request, actual fact sheets and conditions, original decision/labeling and lifecycle transition; no generic device template masquerading as a vaccine application.

rows.need: Classification/jurisdiction and primary-mode-of-action rationale for combination products.
rows.observedLimit: RFD exists under the device segment but resolves a generic pre-sub meeting outline, not the detailed constituent/modes-of-action/PMOA/jurisdiction reasoning described by FDA.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Product/constituent identity and intended use, each mode of action, supported PMOA or assignment rationale, sponsor classification/jurisdiction recommendation, current RFD instructions and source evidence.

rows.need: Applicable licensed-manufacturer biological-product deviations, lot-release and establishment-related work.
rows.observedLimit: Existing CMC/quality stores must be credited, but BLA/CMC headings alone do not establish every specialty reporting workflow.600.14 deviation reporting is separate; full original-form/lot-release/establishment-path coverage was not traced exhaustively here.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Trace exact current source owners and product-specific obligations before creating new templates; qualify the actual original report/form and submission channel, not a similarly named QMS document.

rows.need: Authority-letter/question intake, source-grounded response, governed revision, independent review and filing-quality document/export.
rows.observedLimit: Response register/revisions/signatures/package services exist. Root is completing the sole-editor bridge. Original DOCX layout/figures/form controls are not retained by current import; ordinary export has limited client-template layout support.
acceptanceEvidenceNeeded: Actual current source letter visibility, exact saved-answer/editor revision CAS and writeback, independent signature digest, source references, accessible history, sponsor layout/TOC/table/figure/cross-reference export tests.

notExhaustive: Product-specific rules, waivers, exceptions, manufacturing and postmarketing commitments require further applicability review.

This is not a complete inventory of veterinary, food/cosmetic, stand-alone device/IVD, state, DEA, HCT/P361, laboratory or institutional IRB obligations. Credit those existing platform owners separately if included in the product promise.

Special designation/voucher/rare-disease, advertising/promotion, inspection-response, withdrawal and other specialty documents require exact current authority and source-owner tracing; absence from these grouped rows is not an absence claim.
releaseConclusion: No blanket completion or Weave-parity claim is supported by this audit. Each relevant workflow needs source-pinned implementation, original/structured artifacts, formatting and human acceptance evidence.
